name: pi-app
title: Pi agent app
description: AgentWorkspace: a whole agent page in one component. Left: the sessions pane (search, New, rename, archive, delete; collapsible, a drawer on a narrow screen). Center: PiChat. Right: the artifact panel (versions, file viewer, auto-open of new artifacts) in the ArtifactWorkspace panel, a full-screen sheet on a phone; it draws files with the kinds the app passes in artifactKinds (defaultKinds of the pi-app-kinds item is the default list). layout="embedded" drops the left column for one compact top bar (title, History, Library, New) that joins an app-shell screen header. Props are data and callbacks; hooks for the conversations handler (useConversations), the chat transport (useRemoteChat) and saved resources (useSaved).

files.content:
/*
 * The words and icons of the pi-app block as plain data: its own (sessions pane, artifact panel, file viewer) and the viewers' it composes
 * (`defaultViewerLabels`). `AgentWorkspace` takes a partial `labels` and `icons`; the chat's go through `chat.labels` and `chat.icons`.
 */
import { createContext, createElement, useContext } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeftIcon, HistoryIcon, LibraryIcon, MessageSquareIcon, PanelLeftIcon, PictureInPicture2Icon, SquarePenIcon, XIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { BlockIcon } from '../button/actions';
import { defaultViewerIcons, defaultViewerLabels } from '../viewer-frame/viewer-window';

export const defaultAppLabels = {
  ...defaultViewerLabels,
  sessionsTitle: 'Chats',
  workspaceNavigation: 'Workspace navigation',
  openNavigation: 'Open navigation',
  closeNavigation: 'Close navigation',
  hideNavigation: 'Hide navigation',
  showNavigation: 'Show navigation',
  chat: 'Chat',
  library: 'Library',
  agent: 'Agent',
  backToChat: 'Back to chat',
  newChat: 'New chat',
  closeSessions: 'Close chats',
  openSessions: 'Open chats',
  hideSessions: 'Hide chats',
  showSessions: 'Show chats',
  history: 'History',
  showHistory: 'Show history',
  hideHistory: 'Hide history',
  floatChat: 'Float chat',
  floatHint: 'Release to float the chat',
  resizePanel: 'Resize artifact panel',
  artifactPanel: 'Artifact panel',
  back: 'Back',
  savedAt: (when: string) => `Saved ${when}`,
  latestSavedAt: (when: string) => `Latest, saved ${when}`,
  olderVersion: 'Older version',
  earlierVersion: 'Earlier version',
  artifactNotText: 'This artifact cannot be shown as text.',
  versionUnavailable: 'This version is not available.',
  noCanvasViewer: 'This host has no canvas viewer (pass one in `viewers.canvas`).',
  fileMissing: 'This file no longer exists.',
  attachmentTooLarge: (limit: string) => `Larger than ${limit}. Not saved.`,
  fileNotText: 'This file cannot be shown as text.',
  videoUnreadable: "This video can't be played here",
  binaryFile: (size: string) => `This is a binary file (${size}); it cannot be shown as text.`,
  fileViewer: (kind: string) => `${kind} viewer`,
  newVersion: 'A new version is available.',
  newerBlobFormat: 'This file points to a large file in a newer format than this page reads. It is shown as it is saved.',
  invalidBlobPointer: (name: string) => `${name}: the upload did not return a valid file pointer.`,
};
export type AppLabels = typeof defaultAppLabels;

export const defaultAppIcons = {
  ...defaultViewerIcons,
  sessionsToggle: PanelLeftIcon as BlockIcon,
  history: HistoryIcon as BlockIcon,
  library: LibraryIcon as BlockIcon,
  chat: MessageSquareIcon as BlockIcon,
  newChat: SquarePenIcon as BlockIcon,
  closeSessions: XIcon as BlockIcon,
  floatChat: PictureInPicture2Icon as BlockIcon,
  back: ArrowLeftIcon as BlockIcon,
};
export type AppIcons = typeof defaultAppIcons;

export interface AppText { readonly labels: AppLabels; readonly icons: AppIcons }
const AppTextContext = createContext<AppText>({ labels: defaultAppLabels, icons: defaultAppIcons });
/** The block's labels and icons (the defaults outside an `AgentWorkspace`). */
export const useAppText = (): AppText => useContext(AppTextContext);
export function AppTextProvider({ value, children }: { readonly value: AppText; readonly children: ReactNode }) {
  return createElement(AppTextContext.Provider, { value }, children);
}

/* The pi-app block's words in French with its viewers', the `locale="fr"` base of `AgentWorkspace`. Typed as `AppLabels`, so a key added in English must be added here too. */
import type { AppLabels } from './app-labels';
import { frenchViewerLabels } from '../viewer-frame/viewer-labels-fr';

export const frenchAppLabels: AppLabels = {
  ...frenchViewerLabels,
  sessionsTitle: 'Conversations',
  attachmentTooLarge: (limit: string) => `Plus grand que ${limit}. Non enregistré.`,
  workspaceNavigation: 'Navigation',
  openNavigation: 'Ouvrir la navigation',
  closeNavigation: 'Fermer la navigation',
  hideNavigation: 'Masquer la navigation',
  showNavigation: 'Afficher la navigation',
  chat: 'Discussion',
  library: 'Bibliothèque',
  agent: 'Agent',
  backToChat: 'Retour à la discussion',
  newChat: 'Nouvelle',
  closeSessions: 'Fermer les conversations',
  openSessions: 'Ouvrir les conversations',
  hideSessions: 'Masquer les conversations',
  showSessions: 'Afficher les conversations',
  history: 'Historique',
  showHistory: 'Afficher l’historique',
  hideHistory: 'Masquer l’historique',
  floatChat: 'Détacher la discussion',
  floatHint: 'Relâchez pour détacher la discussion',
  resizePanel: 'Redimensionner le panneau',
  artifactPanel: 'Document',
  back: 'Retour',
  savedAt: when => `Enregistré ${when}`,
  latestSavedAt: when => `Dernière version, enregistrée ${when}`,
  olderVersion: 'Version précédente',
  earlierVersion: 'Version antérieure',
  artifactNotText: 'Ce document ne peut pas être affiché comme du texte.',
  versionUnavailable: 'Cette version n’est pas disponible.',
  noCanvasViewer: 'Cet espace n’a pas d’afficheur de canevas (à fournir dans `viewers.canvas`).',
  fileMissing: 'Ce fichier n’existe plus.',
  fileNotText: 'Ce fichier ne peut pas être affiché comme du texte.',
  videoUnreadable: 'Cette vidéo ne peut pas être lue ici',
  binaryFile: size => `Fichier binaire (${size}) ; il ne peut pas être affiché comme du texte.`,
  fileViewer: kind => `Afficheur ${kind}`,
  newVersion: 'Une nouvelle version est disponible.',
  newerBlobFormat: 'Ce fichier renvoie à un gros fichier dans un format plus récent que celui que cette page lit. Il est affiché tel qu’il est enregistré.',
  invalidBlobPointer: name => `${name} : l’import n’a pas renvoyé de référence de fichier valide.`,
};
